rationale: Design import now fails closed or warns on malformed input that it used to accept silently: ZIP members that collide on extraction refuse the import; parse_design_ir_json refuses an envelope version newer than it reads; the native resolver/materializer warn on unknown node types, duplicate stable anchors and undecodable image assets (a new canvas probe_image_file); browser capture health lists web fonts Chromium could not decode and the lowering warns on each. Every change narrows what is accepted or adds a diagnostic; output for well-formed input is unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves; Pulp-only per the 2026-10-04 owner decision, Vellum inherits.
